// Wrong on purpose: swallows the parse failure.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import { createStore } from "@get-modular/observation";
import {
  createNotifier, parseQuietHours, type NotificationStatus, type NotificationsDeps, type NotificationsProduct,
} from "./i-errors.types.js";

export async function createNotificationsModule(deps: NotificationsDeps, { resources }: ModuleContext): Promise<NotificationsProduct> {
  const quiet = deps.settings.read(["quietHours"]);
  const notifier = createNotifier(parseQuietHours(quiet.values.quietHours));
  deps.settings.watch(quiet, {
    resources, name: "notifications/quiet-hours",
    onChange: ({ values }) => { try { notifier.setQuietHours(parseQuietHours(values.quietHours)); } catch { /* ignore invalid input */ } },
  });
  const status = createStore<NotificationStatus>({ muted: false }, { name: "notifications/status", resources, reportError: deps.errors.report });
  return { instance: notifier, capabilities: { "acme/notifications": { mute: (muted) => { status.set({ muted }); return undefined; } }, "acme/notifications/status": status.readonly() } };
}
